title: Semantic Asset Taxonomy, Availability Resolver & Cross-Pack Substitution

resolved_contract.taxonomy: Provider-neutral requirement descriptors identify acceptable asset kinds, semantic role, required tags and compatibility tokens independently from pack/provider identity.
resolved_contract.eligibility: A candidate must be catalogued, semantically compatible, and have explicit granted useInExperience permission. Cross-pack substitution additionally requires explicit granted substitute permission. Denied or unknown permission is never treated as allowed.
resolved_contract.ranking: Eligible candidates are deterministically ranked by manual pin when valid, same-package exact compatibility, cross-pack explicit compatibility, semantic specificity, stable asset/package/source identifiers; ranking cannot invent semantic equivalence.
resolved_contract.manual_rule: Manual assignment and override are first-class. An explicitly chosen ineligible candidate remains an explained unresolved/manual-rejected result rather than silently falling back to another asset.
resolved_contract.placeholder_rule: Approved placeholder is an explicit caller policy outcome and never silently substitutes for missing or incompatible art.
resolved_contract.receipt_rule: Resolver receipts are stable across platform and registry ordering and include requirement identity, policy, ordered candidate evidence, outcome, selected asset when any, and ordered rejection diagnostics.
resolved_contract.acquisition_rule: Resolution operates only over supplied/catalogued evidence and performs no download, purchase, authentication, scraping, provider API ingestion or payment.
resolved_contract.owner_rule: Resolver outputs select or describe presentation assets only; MIB-11/D18, D29, Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions and Combat/Exploration retain canonical owner truth.

preserved_boundaries: no vendor/editor or source format becomes canonical Multiversal map truth
no asset pack is assumed complete
semantic scene requirements remain separate from selected/available art
MAI-01 license evidence and incomplete-pack outcomes remain binding
MAI-06 raw source/import diagnostics, checksum, provenance and unsupported metadata remain preserved evidence
permissions are not inferred and unknown permission remains unresolved
manual assignment, approved-placeholder and visibly-unresolved outcomes remain first-class
cross-pack substitution cannot invent semantic compatibility or owner state
no automatic provider acquisition/download, payment or authentication
MIB-11/D18, D29, Scene/Tabletop, Visibility/Permissions and Combat/Exploration retain owner truth
migration 0022 remains unreserved absent demonstrated durable schema delta
no real-money commerce, tester distribution, release/deployment or provider/payment activation
validation_requirement: Exact application candidate must pass focused MAI-07 verifier, client typecheck and regression; MAI-06..01 and MIB-11 owner regressions; Repository Health; self-hosted Linux and Windows Validation Core; and deterministic cross-platform comparison before merge.
next_action: Implement only MAI-07 on the registered integration branch. Do not start MAI-08 or widen into workbench/runtime integration, provider acquisition, persistence, migration, release/deployment, payment or real-money behavior.
